entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid search combining RAG and memory. It provides automated fact extraction and connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that uses a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity edges without LLM calls. It supports multi-user scoped access and runs on local hardware using PGLite.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context using a virtual filesystem with viking:// URIs. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system for agents that supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It offers Python and Node.js client SDKs and acts as an LLM wrapper for existing agents.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that provides a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted use. It supports Python and TypeScript client SDKs and offers hybrid search with prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control. It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface with sub-100ms retrieval.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It supports multiple providers and generates filesystem-based traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no message is lost. It utilizes a SQLite-backed message store to build depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted Honcho memory backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers or local inference servers via Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores information as human-readable YAML engrams on a local disk for multi-agent systems. It supports hybrid search stacks and integrates with MCP tools including Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to provide memory through MCP and plugin integrations.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% in tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recall. It supports an in-process embedded mode and includes a self-directing loop to identify and address knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context for an agent, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It operates as a local-first service that renders context directly to files like AGENTS.md.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing data in inspectable Markdown files. It functions without a daemon or opaque databases, utilizing DuckDB solely as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database file to manage agent memory. It features a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory provider, this plugin supports immediate event deletion and uses an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools for searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to handle self-directed payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It facilitates financial autonomy by enabling APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for them in just a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing, organizing skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It provides tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal, with an optional feature for generating automatic tool-routing notes using model calls.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and utilizes configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It supports multiple retrieval methods, including HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index search, and can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, while performing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Operating entirely over localhost, this plugin provides private local code memory for repositories. It supports semantic and literal code search and enables grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development for engineering tasks while emphasizing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology compatible with various harnesses like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that provides a CLI for coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It generates exports in formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4 while utilizing a dedicated design system for brand visual language.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It processes data from any format and offers client support for both Rust and TypeScript.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to six industry frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for specialized security tasks.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions and Mermaid text. It features 11 diagram presets and includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, this tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It utilizes a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table to refine output.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates the evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement of skills across multiple agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs to unify skill sets collectively.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill manages natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution. It connects fragmented ecosystem layers by combining official protocol skills into a single catch-all tool.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers spec-conformant agent plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io. It includes 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a local documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of 822 professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The repository provides ready-to-paste exports for use across various assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Powered by TranscriptAPI, this tool provides search, transcript, channel, and playlist capabilities for agents. It is built in the Agent Skills format and supports platforms including Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Windsurf.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific domains. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular skill packages that utilize progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency. It supports both programmatic skills and remote registries, allowing for structured resource and instruction management.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes for varying complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory via file-backed or SQLite cards. It facilitates cross-feature learning and includes a CLI for managing tasks and card-based memory.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. They provide support for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and specialized CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration resources in Portuguese. All skills are maintained in the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This repository offers official integration for FLUX image and video generation, including specialized skills for FLUX 3 video models. It provides API documentation, code examples, and specific prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 models.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It extracts function signatures and types from source materials while maintaining a complete audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, and supports commerce functionality through TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from failures.

entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.

This approach reduces token usage before LLM calls and includes graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool uses three parallel subagents to hunt for adversarial bugs, edge cases, and integration impacts. It performs deterministic pre-scans with tools like Semgrep and Bandit, then verifies findings through sandbox execution.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple interfaces by tailoring rewrites to specific model families and reasoning capabilities. It preserves non-English prompts using language heuristics and tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Hermeshub serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified investigation protocols to Hermes, utilizing multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for persistent state management and systematic causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports automatic registration of skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a three-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to manage modifications and detects language-specific anti-patterns like N+1 queries.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios from 2015 through 2026.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and is compatible with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports the Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures via a public API.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion and provides action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers diverse utility tools, including video-to-text transcription and privacy-focused local OCR for images and PDFs. It also features a studio for batch generating e-commerce materials with brand overlays.

It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with optional API and webhook listeners.

entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This Docker-based sandbox includes official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. Users can build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides monitoring tools for per-agent metrics and LLM budget caps alongside REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes instances with distinct identities and workspaces. It facilitates task scheduling, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is built for production environments to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable package allows Hermes to run from a USB drive without host system installation. It simultaneously supports Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes while bundling necessary tools like Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It runs entirely locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux, featuring an auto-sync capability to keep the graph current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and supports data submission for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer designed to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes Agent and Cursor. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions and automatically redacts authentication headers to ensure security.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It supports real-time data synchronization across multiple machines to track account limits and session details.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project offers CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create custom aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using YAML-based configurations for banners, colors, and spinners.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments alongside human-readable identity handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control through MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory tools and integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph across platforms like Slack and VS Code. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.

entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories to get a production-ready stack running in minutes.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies overlapping tool descriptions, inconsistent schemas, and missing stop conditions through local execution or CI/CD integrations.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.

entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this tool offers a web-based interface for accessing Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It includes a workspace file browser with inline previews and supports connectivity via SSH tunnels.

entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace introduces a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex agent tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for agent memory and skills.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other CLI agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports task delegation to sub-agents and offers native mobile clients for both iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this application provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It features native views for organizing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.

entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that supports Hermes and various other coding-agent CLIs. It provides searchable history with transcript inspection and live per-session quota burn-rates for specific models.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that bridges local agents to a web interface via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for managing requests that involve side effects.

entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent that provides real-time log streaming and chat. The interface integrates a file browser and a dashboard for tracking tasks, skills, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It offers real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes a marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a PM orchestrator.
